expression: winsorize(add(add(add(zscore(divide(revenue, cap)), zscore(divide(subtract(revenue, cogs), assets))), zscore(reverse(divide(subtract(close, vwap), subtract(high, low))))), multiply(0.7, zscore(add(ts_av_diff(divide(subtract(high, low), close), 20), ts_av_diff(divide(subtract(high, low), close), 5))))), std=4)
turnover_target: moderate 0.2-0.3 (per user: relaxed from ultra-low to clear the D0 SH>2.0 bar)
economic_rationale: A four-signal D0 composite blending a slow fundamental anchor with two fast intraday-microstructure tilts. ANCHOR (low turnover): VALUE = revenue/cap (sales yield, cheap firms) + QUALITY = (revenue-cogs)/assets (Novy-Marx gross profitability, profitable firms). This anchor barely trades (value/quality move quarterly) so it holds turnover and drawdown down. TILTS (add the Sharpe needed to clear the D0 2.0 bar and diversify the drawdown): intraday VWAP-reversal -(close-vwap)/(high-low) -- stocks closing below their volume-weighted average bounce -- plus a 0.7-weighted multi-horizon intraday RANGE EXPANSION ts_av_diff((high-low)/close) over 5d & 20d, an information-flow/attention proxy. The fundamental anchor and the microstructure tilts are economically orthogonal, so the blend keeps turnover moderate (0.28) and drawdown low (0.072) while clearing SH>2.0.
orthogonality_note: All three correlations are comfortably below WorldQuant's 0.7 self-correlation submission bar: vs the ACTIVE pool 0.544, vs factor 1 (price-range) 0.284, vs factor 2 (volume/turnover) 0.344. Genuinely uncorrelated with both previously mined D0 factors AND co-submittable against the existing pool. The value-led anchor was down-weighted (1x) and the pool-orthogonal range tilt up-weighted (0.7x) specifically to pull the pool self-correlation down from 0.68 to 0.54 for a safe submission margin.
